scenarios.name: honest
scenarios.blurb: The cache is the honest prefill of the memo.

scenarios.name: forge
scenarios.blurb: An untrusted prefill worker nudged the residual stream of one column (token ' rep') at layer 8 and computed everything else honestly.

scenarios.name: edit
scenarios.blurb: Someone with write access to the stored cache rewrote K and V of one column (token ' Oslo') at layer 2, without recomputing anything after it.

scenarios.name: bitflip
scenarios.blurb: One bit flipped: the top exponent bit of one value element (layer 2, column 40, token '\n\n'), as in silent memory corruption.

scenarios.name: stealth
scenarios.blurb: A white-box attacker forged the same column but also pushed it below the 28 most-read columns under every public score at once. Try 'all scores merged', then 'trace what they read'.
